text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai, Мэйсё Дото's
first race
goal of her very own, is today.
It's also the first
race of her senior year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, no, no... Wh-wh-wh-wh-what
sh-should I
dooo?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I've never felt this much pressure...
making your
own goals really changes
things.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can do this... But I'm the
reason
I'm here.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo. Try to calm down, Doto...
Oh
nooo... Oh nooo...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Ack, you're right! I shouldn't just fan the
flames of
anxiety.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I have to do this. I have to.
Opera O
is expecting me in her spring
G1.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото comes back to her senses.
Her
mental fortitude has really
improved.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, wow, wow... You two can certainly
hold
your ground. And the way you
encouraged Doto
just now, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be any more pathetic... I'm
supposed to
have more experience, but I
haven't offered a
single thing.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The least I can do is make my cheering
today
extra supportive! Do your best,
Doto! May all
your wishes come true!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Carrying many high expectations,
Мэйсё Дото
enters the stage of today's
graded race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
